We are a research group in the [Department of Economics](https://www.ekon.sun.ac.za)
at [Stellenbosch University](https://www.sun.ac.za). We study consumer financial
markets in developing countries, and in South Africa in particular: how they
work, and which policies would make them work more efficiently and more
equitably.

We use the tools of applied microeconomics to study how households make
financial decisions and what shapes the choices they make. To do this, we
seek out survey and administrative data from sources in the public and private
sectors.

## Working with us

We are a new and growing centre, and we are looking for data partners, research
funding, and postdocs. If you are interested in working with us, please
[get in touch](about/contact.qmd).
